page_policy: Separate typed row/column/cell keyset cursors; no hidden truncation. Cursor HMAC binds authorized projected ID/version fingerprint, actor, tenant, permissions, asOf, filters and sort; current drift rejects409. Repeatable-read transaction per page, no snapshot creation or DB lease.
filter_policy: Unsupported filter for matrix_type rejects400, not silently ignored. Frameworks matrix requires both exact editions; other framework filters only where a canonical join exists. source_framework_version_id mandatory when its Requirement population must be bounded.
empty_policy: Authorized empty relation set is empty; dependency/rights failure is not silently converted to valid empty data. Hidden-object counts never returned.
paired_period_filters: period_start and period_end must be both present or absent; start<end; assessed_at range is [start,end).
cell_window_policy: Cell cursors bind the exact row/column window. Exhaust next_cell_cursor for that window before advancing an axis; repeat the same authorized axes in continuation responses. All cell references must resolve to an axis in that window.
